exposure: Red blood cell transfusion (RBCT) post NEC diagnosis
outcome: Deterioration of Necrotizing Enterocolitis (NEC) from Bell's stage II to stage III
cohort: The study included 242 near-term and full-term infants diagnosed with Bell's stage II Necrotizing Enterocolitis (NEC) between January 1, 2010, and January 31, 2020.
finding: Red blood cell transfusion (RBCT) post-diagnosis of NEC was associated with a significantly increased risk of NEC deteriorating from stage II to stage III in full-term and near-term infants.
